issues.explanation: No Pest/PHPUnit tests ship with the change despite conventions requiring tests for every feature including failure and authorization paths.
The code closure reads attributes queue_id which is a Queue factory instance by default, but nextCode expects int, so Ticket factory without forQueue can TypeError instead of allocating A001.
call locks a fresh instance but then mutates and saves the original stale instance instead of the locked row, risking lost updates or stale writes under concurrency.
CHANGELOG.md under Unreleased was not updated despite docs-in-sync requiring it.
Membership is checked inline via memberships query instead of authorizing through a policy or gate as conventions require.
database-schema update only adds created_at and updated_at and does not document the new queues and tickets tables, uniques, FK cascades, or recommended index.
Uses fully qualified App Enums TicketStatus inline instead of the imported enum like the rest of the file.
Uses Fillable attribute instead of the fillable property the conventions and task describe, diverging from likely sibling style.

conventions.evidence: No tests shipped violating TDD/no production code without a test; CHANGELOG.md missing; manual membership check instead of policy/gate; #[Fillable] vs $fillable at app/Models/Queue.php:151

readability.evidence: Clear names and small focused methods; nit: fully-qualified \App\Enums\TicketStatus::Waiting at app/Actions/IssueTicket.php:45 vs imports

requirements.evidence: IssueTicket locks queue row and rejects inactive at app/Actions/IssueTicket.php:32 with retry on unique collision; nextCode at app/Models/Ticket.php:247 handles A001/A1000/deletion/malformed and write-once/single-call covered; but TicketFactory at database/factories/TicketFactory.php:366 passes unresolved queue_id Factory to nextCode(int)

scope.evidence: All hunks serve the task: models/enums/action/factories/migrations plus required docs updates; no unrelated refactors at change.diff:1-510

security.evidence: Ticket.php:282 checks entity membership server-side and throws AuthorizationException before save; IssueTicket.php:22 validates priority and locks queue; no XSS or Livewire surface; minor mass-assignment surface via fillable called_*

simplicity.evidence: Lean IssueTicket retry loop and nextCode insertion-order scan; reuses Eloquent/DB, no service layers or speculative abstractions

tests.evidence: change.diff:1-510 contains no tests/, Pest files, or unauthorized/tamper coverage for issuance and call

review.summary: Adds queues/tickets persistence, issuance with row-lock and retry, and single-call with membership check, correctly handling code sequencing and write-once rules. Missing tests plus a Ticket factory queue_id typing flaw and stale-instance save in call prevent approval without changes.
